svg.text: INTERNAL INTERCONNECT · PicoRV32 native memory bus + address decoder
Mobile app + cloud booking / payment service
qualified sensor + limit signals (direct wires, not via the bus)
booking checks, bay candidate choice, 15/45-minute deadlines, backup recovery, billing IDs
timestamped event capture, atomic bay commit, beam passage decoding, obstruction interlock
ACPR, barrier motor and display drivers (allowed as black boxes by the challenge)
Firmware requests moves; only RTL drives the motor, so a software bug cannot close a barrier on a car.
